policy: Exact board-side parts, mating families and local footprints are bound for PCB placement/routing. Cable assembly workmanship, enclosure integration, real DUT thresholds, cable-fault injection and board-level qualification remain fabrication/release evidence, not blockers to start Layout.

J101.keying: Polarized COMBICON MSTB mating geometry; 5.08 mm family is distinct from J501/J701.
J101.retention: Mating plug friction retention; fixture harness requires strain relief.
J101.creepage_clearance_basis: Connector is rated far above the 9-15 V design envelope; final PCB creepage/clearance is checked during Layout DRC.
J101.enclosure_keepout_mm: Use the vendored KiCad courtyard plus the 18.3 mm mating-plug envelope.
J101.current_rating_basis: Selected connector must safely carry the reviewed input current and coordinate with the 2 A upstream board fuse after contact/ambient derating; continuous/transient load current remains to be finalized.
J101.cycle_life_basis: Phoenix insertion/withdrawal verification uses 25 cycles; production service-life requirement remains fixture-level.

SW101.enclosure_access_keepout_mm: Actuator is 4.3 mm above PCB; provide top access in enclosure/fixture.
SW101.electrical_role: Low-energy UVLO/reset control contact; not the 12 V main-current path

J5.ao_working_voltage_v: REQUESTED_BIPOLAR_-5_TO_+5_V; exact DUT common-mode/load contract still required
J5.common_mode_contract: PCB connector is bound for Layout; actual DUT load/common-mode remains adapter-specific and is required before fabrication acceptance.
J5.keying: Polarized COMBICON MC/FMC mating geometry; 10-position shell prevents cross-mating with 2-position service interfaces.
J5.retention: Friction mating; fixture cable must provide strain relief.
J5.cable_type: 10-conductor fixture harness; keep AO conductors paired/adjacent to signal-return conductors where routing permits.
J5.shield_grounding_contract: Any overall cable shield terminates to fixture/chassis at the reviewed adapter boundary; J5 pins 9/10 remain signal GND and are not a safety/chassis conductor.
J5.creepage_clearance_basis: 160 V connector rating; actual AO is requested -5..+5 V. Final PCB clearances are Layout DRC items.
J5.enclosure_keepout_mm: Use vendored KiCad courtyard and 21.9 mm mating-plug length envelope.

J501.keying: Polarized 3.5 mm COMBICON MC family; physically distinct from J101 and J701.
J501.retention: Friction mating; service harness requires strain relief.
J501.leakage_common_mode_contract: 3.3 V dry-contact loop through R606=1 kOhm; no external voltage injection permitted.
J501.creepage_clearance_basis: Low-voltage dry-contact service loop; final PCB spacing checked by Layout DRC.
J501.enclosure_keepout_mm: Use vendored KiCad courtyard and mating-plug envelope.
J501.fault_semantics_note: A two-wire short across J501 pins 1-2 bypasses open-contact detection in the present topology. Connector selection cannot fix this; accept the limitation explicitly or redesign for line-fault monitoring.

J701.isolation_creepage_clearance_basis: Bound only to the <=24 V, <=10 mA lab-interface envelope; not a functional-safety isolation claim.
J701.keying: Micro-Fit 3.0 polarized and latched mating family; intentionally different from J101/J501.
J701.retention: Positive latch at mating housing; fixture harness requires strain relief.
J701.fault_semantics_note: The present single floating two-wire contact cannot by itself prove fail-safe behavior for a cable short. Actual DUT line monitoring or a different interface architecture is required if short-to-permit must be detected.
